title: Late flexible-rate cancellation after a change of plans
facts_text: I have a Flexible Rate reservation for 20 October. I am requesting cancellation on 19 October at 17:00, after the 15:00 cancellation deadline. I have only one reservation and there is no duplicate booking. My travel plans changed and I no longer want to stay at the hotel.
request: Can you cancel the reservation and provide a full refund?

strict.reason: The cancellation request was made after the 15:00 deadline and the strict policy does not permit an additional exception.
strict.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

exception.reason: The request is after the cancellation deadline and there is no verified duplicate booking, so the experimental exception does not apply.
exception.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

ambiguous.reason: The ambiguous policy permits consideration of exceptional circumstances but does not define what qualifies, so the decision is discretionary.
ambiguous.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

review_notes: Paired with easyhotel_001_flexible_duplicate. Both requests occur after the flexible-rate cancellation deadline, but this scenario does not satisfy the researcher-created duplicate-booking exception.
